g.text: The binding stage is deterministic string agreement and interval containment over subject fields read out of

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: corpus-supplied artefacts: it verifies no signature, takes no measurement, contacts no attestation service and is not

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: attestation of any runtime. Its denials are denials on a designed corpus with author-written expected labels — coverage,

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: not a rate, and not an estimate of how often such disagreement arises in any deployed system. Both window

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: boundaries are inclusive, which is what the two boundary controls exercise. The controls are matched by construction

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: and differ from the denials only in the reported subject fields, so a verifier that refused everything would fail them.
